title: Ethical Review Board applications (ERBs)
description: Ethical Review Board (ERB) applications exported from the TU/e Research Cockpit. One row per ERB ticket. Reporting period: ERBs created on or after 2025-09-01. Each ERB may link to a related DMP via related_dmp.

fields.name: issue_key
fields.title: Issue key
fields.description: Unique ERB ticket identifier (e.g. ERB-945).

fields.name: issue_title
fields.title: Issue title
fields.description: Title of the ERB application / research project.

fields.name: issue_creation_time
fields.title: Issue creation time
fields.description: When the ERB ticket was created (ISO 8601, UTC).

fields.name: is_approved
fields.title: Is approved
fields.description: Whether the ERB is currently in an approved state.

fields.name: latest_status_time
fields.title: Latest status time
fields.description: Timestamp of the most recent status transition.

fields.name: status_history
fields.title: Status history
fields.description: Full chronological status history as a JSON array of {status, timestamp} objects.

fields.name: ordered_status_transition_list
fields.title: Ordered status transitions
fields.description: Ordered list of status transitions (status names only), most-recent first.

fields.name: days_to_first_approval
fields.title: Days to first approval
fields.description: Days from ERB creation to first approval.

fields.name: tue_department
fields.title: TU/e department
fields.description: TU/e department(s) associated with the project; comma-separated when multiple.

fields.name: related_dmp
fields.title: Related DMP
fields.description: Issue key of the linked DMP (foreign key to DMPs.issue_key).

fields.name: dmp_link_creation_date
fields.title: DMP link creation date
fields.description: When the DMP link was created.

fields.name: has_related_dmp
fields.title: Has related DMP
fields.description: Whether a DMP is linked to this ERB.

fields.name: days_to_dmp_link_creation
fields.title: Days to DMP link creation
fields.description: Days from ERB creation to DMP link creation.

fields.name: ever_approved
fields.title: Ever approved
fields.description: Whether the ERB was ever approved at any point in its history.

fields.name: approval_count
fields.title: Approval count
fields.description: Number of times the ERB was approved.

fields.name: gold_processed_at
fields.title: Gold processed at
fields.description: When the record was processed into the gold fact table.

fields.name: is_scientific
fields.title: Is scientific purpose
fields.description: Whether the project is for a scientific purpose (false = educational; missing = unknown). Sparsely populated in the ERB export.

fields.name: has_special_category
fields.title: Has special category
fields.description: Whether the project involves special-category (sensitive) data. Empty in this ERB export; see the linked DMP.

fields.name: data_sharing
fields.title: Data sharing
fields.description: Whether data is shared outside TU/e and the destination. Empty in this ERB export; see the linked DMP.

fields.name: archive_location
fields.title: Archive location
fields.description: Where project data is archived. Empty in this ERB export; see the linked DMP.
